displayName: Expected Value and the Kelly Criterion
description: Activate when: user asks 'how much should I bet/invest on this?', 'what's the expected value here?', 'Kelly criterion', 'optimal bet size', 'fractional Kelly', 'how big a position should I take?', or is allocating capital across repeated decisions (ad spend by segment, VC portfolio construction, position sizing, A/B test ramp). Do NOT activate when: the decision is one-shot and non-repeating (career change, marriage) — use regret-minimization instead; or when the user cannot estimate probabilities or payoffs even roughly. More: deciqai.com/c/expected-value-and-kelly
